operational_result.Roi_Namur: Secure declared morning 8-Feb after pocket checks; only isolated hidden individuals remain.
operational_result.Kwajalein: Organized island resistance collapses late afternoon/early evening 8-Feb. Operational control is US, but isolated shelters/groups remain and a formal secure declaration should follow after night/morning verification.
operational_result.air: Regional Japanese coherent strike capability is effectively gone; 6-9 serviceable aircraft remain, largely reconnaissance/water/local-defense types.
operational_result.sea: No additional major US ship hit centered. Japanese submarines continue to impose ASW and escort cost but their effective geometry is thinning.

US_Dplus2_ground_casualties.note: Ground/landing-area fighting only; separate 5-Feb LST personnel losses remain outside this total.

cumulative_main_landing_battles_through_.guard: Main Roi-Namur and Kwajalein ground battles only; do not mix in carrier-air, submarine, naval or LST personnel losses.

next_frontier: 1944-02-08T24 Marshall local; resolve 8/9-Feb isolated pocket clearance, Kwajalein secure declaration, prisoner/intelligence capture, and post-assault support/airfield transition.
